A.s: Hive makes HDFS data queryable with SQL-like syntax. What does Hive compile HiveQL queries into?
A.e: Hive 將 HiveQL 編譯成 MapReduce jobs（physical plan = DAG of MapReduce jobs），所以 latency 高。用 Spark RDD 執行嘅係 Shark。

A.s: In Hive's data model, how is a partition of a table stored in HDFS?
o: As a file inside the table directory
As a row in the metastore only
As a sub-directory of the table's directory
As a column of the table
A.e: Table = directory；partition = sub-directory；bucket = partition directory 入面嘅 file。

A.s: What observation motivated Shark to use in-memory computation for petabyte-scale data warehouses?
o: Data warehouse queries show strong temporal locality; about 90% of Facebook queries could be served from main memory
All Facebook data fits into one machine's RAM
A.e: 大部分 query 只睇細嘅數據 window（例如每日 log），而且最近用過嘅數據好快會再用（temporal locality）。

A.s: Which of the following is NOT supported by Shark?
A.e: Shark 唔支援 bucketing、唔同 partition 用唔同 input format、合併細 output file、自動 map-side join。

A.s: Spark SQL added which two key features on top of Spark core?
o: The DataFrame API and the Catalyst optimizer
A.e: L4 slide 41：Spark SQL 加咗 DataFrames 同 extensible optimizer（Catalyst）。

A.s: Why is the Spark engine limited in optimizing rdd.map(lambda x: ...)?
o: Lambdas run on the driver only
The functions passed to RDD transformations are black boxes, so the engine cannot inspect their logic
Python lambdas are not allowed in Spark
A.e: RDD API 收任意 function，Spark 睇唔到入面做咩，所以 Catalyst 冇辦法優化。DataFrame 係 declarative，有 schema。

A.s:
df2 = df.filter(df.quantity > 20).withColumn("revenue", df.quantity * df.price)

When does Spark actually execute this computation?
o: When an output operation such as show() or count() is called
Never; DataFrames are computed eagerly at creation
A.e: DataFrame 係 lazy：每個 DataFrame 只代表 logical plan，去到 output operation（count、show、save）先執行。

A.s: Which code converts an RDD of tuples into a DataFrame using an explicit schema (without .toDF())?
A.e: 練習卷 Q1(a) 嘅答案：spark.createDataFrame(rdd, schema)，schema 用 StructType([StructField(...), ...])。

A.s: When creating a PySpark UDF with udf(...), what must you provide?
o: The Python function and the return data type, e.g. udf(f, StringType())
A.e: L5 slide 28：UDF 有兩部分：function 同 output datatype。

A.s: Studying how “draw”, “draws”, “drawing” and “undrawable” are built from a root plus affixes belongs to which area of linguistics?
A.e: Morphology 研究 morpheme（最細有意義單位）點樣組成字：root + prefix／suffix。

A.s: Mapping “am, are, is” → “be” is an example of:
A.e: Lemmatization 還原到字典形式（lemma）。Stemming 只係切詞綴，例如 computing → comput。

A.s: Why does character tokenization usually work better than word tokenization for Chinese?
o: Chinese is written without spaces between words, and word tokenization gives a huge vocabulary with many rare words
Chinese words are always one character long
A.e: 中日韓泰冇空格分詞；每個中文字大致係一個意思單位；用詞做 token 會令 vocabulary 好大兼好多罕見字。

A.s: Using PySpark's IDF = log((N + 1) / (df + 1)), what is the IDF of a term that appears in all 3 documents of a 3-document corpus?
A.e: log((3+1)/(3+1)) = log(1) = 0。所有文件都有嘅字冇區分能力。

A.s: What is the Levenshtein distance between “kitten” and “sitting”?
Which statement correctly contrasts Skip-gram and CBOW?
o: Skip-gram predicts the context words from the centre word; CBOW predicts the centre word from the context words
Skip-gram predicts the centre word from the context; CBOW predicts the context from the centre word
Both predict the next word only
Skip-gram uses co-occurrence matrix factorization; CBOW uses negative sampling
A.e: Skip-gram：center → context；CBOW：context → center。Co-occurrence matrix 係 GloVe。

B.s: Hive is designed mainly for:
o: Data warehousing / online analytical processing (OLAP) in batch
B.e: Hive 係 petabyte 級 data warehouse，唔係 OLTP，專注 scalability 同 extensibility。

B.s: Which is a limitation of Hive described in the lecture?
o: It cannot handle petabytes of data
High latency, because queries run as MapReduce jobs, so even small queries can take minutes
B.e: Hive 限制：high latency、唔啱互動式分析、複雜 query 慢、冇內置 ML／iterative algorithm。

B.s: For SELECT AVG(age) FROM users, what is the main benefit of column-oriented storage (used by Shark and Parquet)?
o: Only the age column is read, reducing I/O
It removes the need for a schema
B.e: Column storage 只讀需要嘅 column；壓縮又好（dictionary／run-length encoding），仲對 JVM GC 友好。

B.s: What does Shark's Partial DAG Execution (PDE) do?
o: Collects statistics at run time (partition sizes, heavy hitters, histograms) and changes the query plan, e.g. choosing a broadcast join or the number of reducers
B.e: PDE 喺執行途中收集統計，worker 送去 master，再動態改 plan：join algorithm（shuffle vs broadcast）、parallelism、skew handling。

B.s: Which Catalyst optimization evaluates constant expressions at compile time, e.g. turning 1+2+t1.value into 3+t1.value?
B.e: Constant folding。Predicate pushdown = 將 filter 推前；loop unrolling = 展開 loop；join reordering = 改 join 次序。

B.s: What does df.withColumn("revenue", df.quantity * df.price) return?
o: Nothing; it modifies df in place
A new DataFrame with all original columns plus revenue
B.e: DataFrame 係 immutable，withColumn 回傳新 DataFrame，保留所有原本 column 再加新 column（所以練習卷 UDF 題要用 withColumn）。

B.s: How do you make a DataFrame people queryable with spark.sql("SELECT ... FROM user")?
B.e: createOrReplaceTempView 註冊成 temporary view；仍然係 unmaterialized，可以同 DataFrame expression 一齊優化。

B.s: df = spark.read.csv("products.csv", header=True) is called without inferSchema or schema. What are the column types?
o: Automatically integer or double where possible
B.e: 冇 inferSchema 又冇 schema，CSV 每個 column 都讀成 string。要 inferSchema=True 或者傳 schema=。

B.s: What does df.rdd return?
o: A list of tuples on the driver
An RDD whose elements are pyspark.sql.Row objects
B.e: 每個元素係 Row（key-value pairs），可以用 x["name"] 或 x.name 攞值。

B.s: In the BPE token learner, what happens in each iteration?
o: The least frequent symbol is deleted
The most frequent adjacent pair of symbols is merged and added to the vocabulary
Each word is split into characters again
B.e: ① 拆成字母 ② 搵最常見嘅相鄰 pair ③ 合併、vocabulary +1 ④ 重複至夠數。

B.s: What is the main purpose of subword tokenization?
o: To handle unknown (out-of-vocabulary) words while keeping the vocabulary small
B.e: 例如訓練有 foot、ball 但冇 football；subword 可以用已知片段砌出新字，亦減細 vocabulary。

B.s: Using the Porter stemmer rule ies → i, what does “companies” become?
B.e: Stemming 結果唔一定係真字：companies → compani。其他規則：sses → ss（classes → class）、s → （cats → cat）。

B.s: The sparse vector (5, [1, 3], [2.0, 4.0]) represents which dense vector?
B.e: 格式 (size, [indices], [values])：長度 5，index 1 = 2.0、index 3 = 4.0，其他 0。

B.s: Which is a limitation of the Bag-of-Words model?
B.e: BoW 只數次數：字序冇咗、encoding 稀疏。N-gram 可以保留局部字序。

B.s: A term gets a high TF-IDF weight in a document when it:
o: Appears often in this document but in few documents of the collection
Appears once in a very long document
B.e: TF 高（喺呢份文件多）× IDF 高（喺 collection 少）= 權重高。

B.s: What does Named Entity Recognition (NER) do?
o: Identifies named entities such as people, locations and organisations
B.e: NER 自動認出 “Peter Parker”（人）、“New York”（地方）等，令文字多啲意義。

B.s: For the word sets {The, quick, brown, fox} and {The, quick, brown, dog}, what is the Sørensen-Dice coefficient?
What is the main weakness of Hamming distance?
o: It only applies to strings of the same length and ignores insertions and deletions
B.e: Hamming 只計 substitution；長度唔同就用唔到，要用 Levenshtein。

B.s: What is the cosine similarity between the one-hot vectors of two different words such as “cat” and “feline”?
B.e: 唔同位置得一個 1，dot product = 0 → cosine = 0。One-hot 捉唔到相似，所以要 embedding。

B.s: “You shall know a word by the company it keeps” expresses:
o: The distributional hypothesis: words in similar contexts have similar meanings
B.e: Firth（1957）；Harris（1954）講 oculist 同 eye-doctor 出現喺差唔多嘅環境。Word2Vec 就係建基於呢個諗法。

B.s: Why does Skip-gram with Negative Sampling (SGNS) replace the softmax?
o: The softmax normalizes over the whole vocabulary V, which is very expensive; SGNS uses binary logistic regression with a sigmoid on positive and k sampled negative pairs
To remove the need for context words
B.e: Positive pair y = 1，隨機抽嘅字 y = 0。要有 negative，否則模型只要將 dot product 變大就令 loss 變細。

B.s: What does GloVe build before learning embeddings?
o: A V × V global word co-occurrence count matrix, which is then factorized
B.e: GloVe = Global Vectors：用成個 corpus 嘅 co-occurrence 統計，快、捉到 global statistics。

B.s: With king = [1, 8, 8], man = [1, 7, 0] and woman = [9, 7, 0], what is king − man + woman?
In standard Skip-gram, every word has a centre vector v and a context vector u. Which is used as the final word embedding?
o: The centre-word vectors V; U is only used during training
B.e: Skip-gram 用 V；CBOW 一般用 context 向量。

B.s: For “The hero saves the day” with window m = 1 and PAD at the edges, how many skip-gram (centre, context) training pairs are there?
B.e: 5 個 centre word × 2 個 context = 10（包括 (The, PAD) 同 (day, PAD)）。唔用 PAD 就係 8。

B.s: Which describes the Monge-Elkan similarity?
o: A hybrid method: for each element of the first set, take the maximum secondary similarity to the second set, then average
The number of substitutions between equal-length strings
Twice the intersection over the total size
B.e: Monge-Elkan 係唯一嘅 hybrid 方法（edit-based + token-based），計算量大，結果視乎 secondary function。B 係 Hamming，C 係 Jaccard，D 係 Dice。

C.s: A retailer runs HiveQL reports on 5 PB of sales data stored in HDFS. Analysts complain that even a small ad-hoc query takes several minutes. What is the most likely reason?
o: Hive keeps all tables in RAM, which overflows
Hive cannot partition tables by date
HiveQL is compiled into MapReduce jobs whose disk-based processing gives high latency
Hive does not support SELECT queries
C.e: Hive 嘅限制：用 MapReduce → high latency，細 query 都要幾分鐘；唔啱 interactive／ad-hoc 分析。

C.s: A Hive table logs is partitioned by date, and each partition is split into 32 buckets by user_id. How is it laid out in HDFS?
o: One directory for the table, one sub-directory per date, and 32 files inside each date sub-directory
One single file for the whole table
32 directories per table and one file per date
Only metadata in the metastore; no files in HDFS
C.e: Table = directory，partition = sub-directory，bucket = sub-directory 入面嘅 file（n 個 bucket = n 個 file）。

C.s: Analysts at a social network mostly query the last 7 days of logs, although the warehouse holds 2 PB. Which observation did Shark exploit to speed up such queries?
o: Temporal locality: the recent working set is small and reused, so it can be cached in memory
C.e: Shark 動機：data warehouse 有 temporal locality，Facebook 90% query 可以喺 memory 完成，唔使將成個 petabyte 放入 memory。

C.s: During a query that joins a huge orders table with customers, Shark's run-time statistics show that the filtered customers table is only 5 MB. What can Partial DAG Execution do?
o: Rewrite the query as a Hive MapReduce job
Switch to a broadcast join, sending the small table to every node instead of shuffling both tables
Remove the join from the plan
C.e: PDE 用 run-time 統計改 plan：細 table → broadcast join（複製細 table 去所有 node），避免兩邊都 shuffle。

C.s: The same logic is written as rdd.map(lambda r: (r[0], r[2]*1.1)).filter(lambda r: r[1] > 100) and as df.withColumn("v", col("x")*1.1).filter(col("v") > 100). Why can the DataFrame version run faster?
o: Catalyst understands the column expressions and can optimize the plan (e.g. predicate pushdown), while RDD lambdas are black boxes
C.e: DataFrame 有 schema + declarative expression，Catalyst 可以優化；RDD 嘅 lambda Spark 睇唔到入面。

C.s: An RDD holds tuples (101, "Hung Hom", 23.5, "2026-11-02 10:00"). Which StructField correctly describes the third element?
C.e: 格式係 StructField(name, dataType, nullable)，dataType 要係 type object（DoubleType()）。23.5 係 double，唔係 integer。

C.s:
def label(t):
    return "Long" if len(t) > 100 else "Short"
label_udf = udf(label, IntegerType())

What happens when label_udf is applied to a text column?
o: The function is rejected when it is defined
The values do not match the declared IntegerType, so the new column is null
C.e: Return type 宣告錯（應該係 StringType()），PySpark 唔會 convert，結果變 null。所以練習卷特登要你 “explicitly declare the correct return type”。

C.s: You must keep every original column of df_reviews and add sentiment_category. Which line is correct?
C.e: withColumn 保留所有原本 column 再加一個；淨係 select UDF 就只剩一欄。

C.s: A chatbot was trained on text containing “foot” and “ball” but never “football”, and it fails when users type “football”. Which technique most directly addresses this?
o: Subword tokenization such as Byte Pair Encoding
C.e: OOV（unknown word）問題 → subword：football 可以由 foot + ball 等已知片段組成。

C.s: A search engine should match a query containing “run” with documents containing “running” and “ran”. Which pre-processing step is most suitable?
C.e: Lemmatization 會將 running、ran 都還原做 run。Stemming 處理到 running，但唔識將不規則嘅 ran 變 run。

C.s: A sentiment model built on single-word features classifies “I don't like this product” as positive because of “like”. Which representation would best fix this?
o: N-gram (e.g. bigram) features so “don't like” becomes one feature
Using the review ID as a feature
C.e: L5／T05：phrase “don't like” 意思相反，用 n-gram 保留局部字序。刪走 “don't” 反而令情況更差。

C.s: A corpus has 4 documents. “spark” appears in only one of them, document D2, where it occurs twice. Using raw TF and IDF = ln((N+1)/(df+1)), what is the TF-IDF of “spark” in D2?
A BPE learner starts from the corpus (“hug”,10), (“pug”,5), (“pun”,12), (“bun”,4), (“hugs”,5). Which pair is merged first?
C.e: u g 出現喺 hug(10) + pug(5) + hugs(5) = 20 次，最多。p u = pug 5 + pun 12 = 17。

C.s: A spell-checker compares the typo “recieve” with dictionary words of different lengths and must allow insertions and deletions. Which measure fits best?
C.e: Hamming 只可以比較等長字串；Levenshtein 計 insert、delete、substitute。

C.s: A tool compares a 20-word abstract with a 2,000-word paper. Which measure gives 1.0 when every word of the abstract appears in the paper, regardless of the paper's length?
C.e: Overlap = |A∩B| / min(|A|, |B|) = 20/20 = 1。Jaccard 同 Dice 會因為 paper 好長而好細。

C.s:
Which TWO statements about word embeddings are correct?
(i) Words that appear in similar contexts tend to get nearby vectors.
(ii) The cosine between one-hot vectors of two different words captures their similarity.
(iii) SGNS replaces the full softmax over V with binary classification on sampled negative words.
(iv) GloVe only looks inside one local context window.
C.e: (ii) 錯：one-hot cosine 永遠 0。(iv) 錯：GloVe 用成個 corpus 嘅 global co-occurrence。Quiz 1 Q14 都係 “Which TWO” 題型。

C.s: A CBOW model is trained with window m = 2, embedding dimension d = 100 and vocabulary size V = 10,000. How many nodes are in the hidden (projection) layer and in the output layer?
C.e: Hidden = d = 100（context 向量取平均，唔係 2m × d）；output = V = 10,000 個 softmax node。
